notes: OEIS140320.A140320_formula: A140320 n = 2n*3^(n-1)+1 for all n, with A002326 n = orderOf (2 : ZMod (2n+1)), A006694 n = ncard of the cyclotomic cosets {x*2^k % (2n+1)} with 1 <= x < 2n+1, A137576 = A002326*A006694+1. Route: ord_two (2 primitive root mod 3^r, LTE via padicValNat.pow_sub_pow), gen, coset_eq/val_mod/coset_inj (one coset per 3-adic valuation). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (reading: the coset {0} not counted, as A006694's data show; OEIS data agreement by certificate/check.py only). Aside: the general A137576 formula a((p^k-1)/2)=1+k*phi(p^k) fails at p=1093, k=2 (certificate/wieferich.py).

sources.what: a((p^k-1)/2) = 1 + k*phi(p^k) for odd primes p, stated without proof; p = 3 is the conjecture

sources.cite: OEIS A006694, FORMULA (Shevelev 2008, confirmed by J. Arndt 2019)

prior_art.note: Immediate from known facts; first Lean proof. The general A137576 prime-power formula is false at Wieferich primes.
